Nkuhlu
TENTED CAMP, KRUGER NATIONAL PARK
Welcome to Nkuhlu Tented Camp, a hidden treasure nestled in the heart of the renowned Kruger National Park. Step into this pristine wilderness and prepare yourself for an extraordinary journey filled with wonder and enchantment.
Immerse yourself in the untouched beauty of the surroundings, where the symphony of nature embraces you, and captivating wildlife roams freely in this unfenced tented camp.

Location & Directions
Perfectly positioned just 25 km east of Skukuza Rest Camp on the H4-1 and 23 km west of Lower Sabie Rest Camp on the H4-1 in the Kruger National Park, Nkuhlu Tented Camp offers an exceptional location for an unforgettable safari experience.
A Perfect Destination
Whether you re a daring adventurer in search of thrilling encounters or a nature enthusiast yearning for serene solitude, Nkuhlu Tented Camp is the ultimate destination.
Explore the awe-inspiring landscapes, where vast golden savannahs stretch as far as the eye can see, and majestic creatures gracefully traverse their natural habitat.
Book your stay today and experience the magic of the Kruger National Park like never before.

Accommodation - Nkuhlu Tented Camp
Skip to content
Stay at Nkuhlu
TENTED CAMP, KRUGER NATIONAL PARK
Experience the true essence of the African wilderness at Nkuhlu Tented Camp. Nestled along the banks of the Sabie River, our seven self-catering tents provide a serene and unforgettable safari experience.
Each spacious tent is designed to comfortably accommodate two adults on a twin or double bed. Inside, you’ll find a well-equipped kitchenette with a fridge, gas stove, and microwave, allowing you to prepare your meals with ease. Step out onto your private patio and indulge in the ultimate South African experience by enjoying a traditional braai under the sparkling stars.
To ensure your comfort and convenience, battery-operated lights have been thoughtfully placed in your tent. These lights will provide illumination during any unexpected power outages, ensuring that you can continue to enjoy your stay without disruption.
At Nkuhlu Tented Camp, we are committed to sustainability and have embraced a fully reliant system on solar power and gas. This approach allows us to provide a harmonious and eco-friendly environment for our valued guests.
Book your stay
Rooms at Nkuhlu
The camp offers seven self-catering tents overlooking the Sabie River. Each tent comfortably accommodates two adults on a twin or double bed.
No children under the age of 12 are allowed due to SANPARKS regulations on unfenced camps.
Each tent has a private patio. 1 child between the age of 12 – 16 years can be accommodated on a sleeper couch. 1 Double Bed / 2 twin beds and 1 sleeper couch. All tents are equipped with a kitchenette, including a fridge and sags hob, and each tent has a private patio with gas braai (BBQ) Self-catering
*To promote fire safety and preserve the natural surroundings, we kindly remind you that no wood fires or open flames are allowed at Nkuhlu Tented Camp. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in creating a safe and sustainable environment.
RIVER TENTED SUITE
Step into a world of tranquil beauty with our River Tented Suite. Seven self-catering tents have been thoughtfully positioned to provide an awe-inspiring vista of the Sabie River. Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature and the soothing melody of the Sabie River, all from the comfort of your River Tented Suite.
BUSH TENTED SUITE
Nestled within the embrace of the African bush, our Bush Tented Suites offer a secluded sanctuary for those seeking a more intimate connection with nature. Away from the river s edge, these tents invite you to immerse yourself in the rustling leaves and the natural surroundings, providing a haven of privacy and tranquility.
Shop at Nkuhlu Park Shop
The Nkuhlu Picnic Site is an exquisite rest spot next to Nkuhlu Tented Camp which has a charming Parks Shop and a fantastic takeaway restaurant, offering a delectable selection of light breakfast and lunch options, including waffles, pizzas, and succulent rotisserie chicken.
The Parks Shop also provides essential supplies that you might have inadvertently left behind and is open daily from 07:00 to 16:00.

Location & Directions - Nkuhlu Tented Camp
Skip to content
Location & Directions
If you re traveling from Johannesburg (JHB) or Pretoria (PTA), the most convenient route to Nkuhlu Tented Camp starts by taking the N4 Highway towards Mbombela. Once you reach Mbombela, continue on the R40 road towards Hazyview. From Hazyview, it s just a short drive where you ll need to turn onto the R536 road towards Paul Kruger Gate on the Skukuza Road.
Once you ve entered Paul Kruger Gate, keep driving straight on Skukuza Road, also known as the H1-2. After a little while, you ll come to a point where you need to make a right turn onto Skukuza-Lower Sabie Road, which is the H4-1 route leading to Nkuhlu Tented Camp.
Distance from Kruger Gate to Nkuhlu Tented Camp – 35km (1 hour, 15 Minutes)
Distance from Skukuza Rest Camp to Nkuhlu Tented Camp – 22km (45 mins)
Distance from Skukuza Airport to Nkuhlu Tented Camp – 25km (45 minutes to 1 hour)
As you journey from these various points, be sure to keep an eye out for the incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes that make Kruger National Park a truly unforgettable destination.
